mutations.name: unlisted-non-uuid-file
mutations.note: A file in attachments/ whose name is not a UUID is ignored.

mutations.name: unlisted-uuid-file
mutations.note: A UUID-named image the manifest does not list is ignored: only listed files are read.

mutations.name: unlisted-upper-case-uuid-file
mutations.note: An upper-case UUID name is just another unlisted name.

mutations.name: unlisted-directory-in-attachments
mutations.note: A folder in attachments/ is ignored.

mutations.name: link-in-place-of-database
mutations.note: journal.sqlite is a link: never followed.

mutations.name: link-in-place-of-listed-image
mutations.note: A listed image is a link: never followed.

mutations.name: link-in-place-of-attachments-folder
mutations.note: attachments/ is a link to a folder: never followed.

mutations.name: sparse-database-above-limit
mutations.note: journal.sqlite of 33 GiB (a sparse file): refused before it is copied.

mutations.name: sparse-image-above-limit
mutations.note: A listed image of 26 MiB (a sparse file): refused before it is copied.

operations: add: write a file (creating folders) with the text; symlink: replace a file with a link to target (relative to the package); symlinkFolder: replace a folder with a link to a new empty folder target; sparse: replace a file with a sparse file of that many bytes; delete: remove a file.

packages.name: manifest-names-a-file-outside
packages.note: A header of version 2 (no password) whose readable manifest lists the name ../x: refused before any file is created, inside or outside the restore.

packages.name: unpacked-file-archive
packages.note: A folder holding an unpacked file archive (archive.json with archiveVersion): not a directory archive.

purpose: What the directory archive reader does with files the manifest does not list, and the hostile folders it refuses (protocol/archive.md). The mutations apply to a copy of encrypted/ in expected.json's archive; the packages are folders in this directory. See README.md.
